ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a dominant high-intensity white base (approx. 75% of surface) interspersed with low-intensity black mottled clusters (approx. 25% of surface).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense, irregular black pigmentation blobs concentrated heavily along the trailing edges of both lobes. The right lobe shows a dispersed pattern of circular spots throughout the central region, while the left lobe shows a larger, contiguous dark cluster near the fluke base at the water line.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped indentation with an estimated pixel-based angle of 70-80 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (saw-tooth pattern) along the right lobe trailing edge. The left lobe displays more irregular, macro-scale indentations and jagged peaks near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature along the trailing edge leading to elongated, tapering distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized high-intensity white clusters (circular morphology) at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe and scattered along the leading edge of the left lobe, indicative of barnacle attachment scars.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant, irregular deep notch is visible on the trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately mid-way between the median notch and the tip, suggesting a healed mechanical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe tip exhibits a nearly solid black pigmentation cap that transitions abruptly into the white ventral field.
